15 minutes a day. That is the routine technology cap a Kenai Peninsula Borough School District draft would set for kindergarten.

The draft reached the Policy Review Committee on August 3rd. For secondary schools it says "routine daily technology limits are not established". Grades 6 through 12 get adjectives instead. It never mentions AI.

This page covered the district's AI rulebook in July. The minute ladder is new since then.

The regulation the district ties to "the inclusion of AI" was on that same agenda in two competing drafts. Neither appears to draw a grade line. Nothing is adopted.

Students start August 19th districtwide.

The minute ladder as drafted, the AI drafts with no grade line, and the seven documents that moved in one day.

Does the AI regulation need grade lines too, or is one standard right for a five year old and a senior?

#AKedu #KenaiPeninsula #AIinSchools

Editor's note

UPDATE FRAMING. This is an explicit update to No.12 (2026-07-20), which covered the same district's AI policy and used the $8,300 MagicSchool purchase as its spine. The dedupe gate was re-run at Phase 6 and returned No.12 as a LIKELY DUPLICATE at jaccard 0.221. The material new development is AR 6161.5 and BP 6161.5, which came to committee as new business on August 3rd and did not exist on the public record in July, and the thesis moved from ORDER to PRECISION. The cover says UPDATE and slide 02 says what is new.

SHORTFALL, disclosed. This run shipped with reduced review. The pixel-critic and flow-critic rounds were cut and the showrunner reviewed the contact sheet directly, at the maintainer's instruction to finish fast under a token constraint. Machine QA is green (0 fails) and the deck is honest, but it has had one pair of eyes rather than five.

CONFLICT OF INTEREST, flagged for your decision. The loudest Alaska AI story this window is the $372,000 six Anthropic employees gave Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins in the governor's race. It fails dedupe against No.17 and No.21, and separately, a deck taking an editorial position on Anthropic employees' donations produced by an Anthropic model is a conflict this page should not take on quietly. Your call whether to cover it, and the conflict belongs on the page if you do.

Aftercare (this is where reach is won)

  • Post Tuesday to Thursday, 8 to 11am Alaska time.
  • Paste the first comment within 60 seconds of posting.
  • Reply to every comment in the first 60 to 90 minutes.
  • The deck is an explicit update to No.12. If a reader says they saw this in July, the honest answer is that the minute ladder is new since August 3rd.
  • Do not repeat the 8,300 dollar figure as an audited number. It is an official's statement to KBBI.
  • Never say the minute caps are an AI rule. They are a technology regulation and it never mentions AI.
